title: Posters and wall displays
summary: Decorating in TCG Card Shop Simulator is sorted by where a thing goes: the game keeps posters, wall pieces and wall-bar pieces as separate lists, so a wall is furnished by kind.
body: Posters are a decoration kind of their own. The game keeps a list of them apart from everything else, which is why a poster is placed as a poster rather than as generic decoration.
Wall decoration is sorted again. There is a list for wall pieces and a separate one for wall-bar pieces, so what fits above a shelf is not the same set as what fits flat on the wall.
The shop sign is not part of that. The billboard carries the shop name and is handled as its own object, which is why renaming the shop and decorating a wall are unconnected jobs.
The game ships artwork for all of it. There is a set of poster images of its own, so what you hang up is drawn from the game's own art rather than imported from outside it.
Decorating is therefore a placement question. Because each kind is listed separately, decorating well is mostly a matter of knowing which list the piece you want lives in.
What this entry does not tell you: how many posters exist, what any of them cost, or whether decoration changes how customers behave. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Posters are kept as a decoration kind of their own.
Wall decoration and wall-bar decoration are listed separately.
The shop billboard is a separate object from wall decoration.
The build names its billboard mesh and an optimised version of it.
The game ships poster images of its own for the wall slots.
The fan-art poster is a mesh the build provides rather than a picture pasted on the wall.
The posters are a numbered set of more than seventy pictures.
facts.evidence: asset names: Poster_1, Poster_10, Poster_50, Poster_72

alt.en: One of the poster images the game ships for wall decoration.

alt.en: A second poster from the game's own set: a dark armoured horned creature standing in a stadium.
alt.zh: 游戏自带海报集中的第二张：一只深色披甲、头生双角的怪物站在体育场中。

alt.en: A third poster from the game's own set: a green and red plant-like creature standing in a field.

alt.en: A fourth poster from the game's own set: a grinning red pig-like creature leaping over a green field, signed Cheka Art.
alt.zh: 游戏自带海报集中的第四张：一只咧嘴笑的红色猪状生物跃过绿色原野，署名 Cheka Art。

alt.en: A fifth poster from the set: a fiery monster drawn as flat red, orange and blue shapes on black, with the card game's name in the corner.
alt.zh: 游戏自带海报集中的第五张：黑底上以红橙蓝平涂色块画出的火焰怪物，角落印着这款卡牌游戏的名字。

alt.en: A sixth poster from the game's set: a round white creature with pink and blue wings drawn in outline on white.
alt.zh: 游戏自带海报集中的第六张：白底描线的圆形白色小怪，长着粉蓝翅膀。

alt.en: A seventh poster from the game's set: a booster box of the card game shown on sale, with a pack propped against it and the words On Sale in the corner.
alt.zh: 游戏自带海报集中的第七张：正在促销的卡牌游戏整盒装，旁边靠着补充包，角落写着 On Sale。

alt.en: An eighth poster from the game's set: a second booster box shown on sale, with a different set's pack propped against it.
alt.zh: 游戏自带海报集中的第八张：又一盒促销中的整盒装，旁边靠着另一系列的补充包。

alt.en: A ninth poster from the game's set: a fox-like creature drawn in flat orange, red and blue shapes on a pale ground.
alt.zh: 游戏自带海报集中的第九张：浅色底上以橙红蓝平涂色块画出的狐形生物。
